releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.8.1 (Forensic Camera Photo Text Editor & Engine Perfection)
changelog:
🚀 Major Flagship Release v10.8.1 — Forensic Realism & Real-World Engine Perfection:
• Forensic Camera Text Editor: Line-level neighboring ink sampling & luminance matching (zero jet-black stickers).
• Seamless Stroke Inpainting: Alpha-channeled inpainting preserving authentic camera paper grain (zero rectangular white patches).
• Optical Camera Blur (PSF): 2-pass alpha-weighted Gaussian convolution eliminates dark halos & matches lens softness.
• Typography Consensus: Terminal flare ratio & line consensus prevents Times New Roman / Serif from mutating to Arial.
• Spine Shadow Remover: Chromaticity-preserving proportional illumination for book pages.
• Micro-Tuning Realism Controls: Live sliders for Camera Blur, Baseline Nudge, Paper Blending, and Ink Tone in Text Edit dialog.
• Engine Hardening: 58 unit tests passing across Devanagari OCR, Receipt GST, Vault AES-256-GCM, and Expiry Watchdog.
